operators.name: custom_nan_to_zero
semantics: For each element of x, if it is NaN, output 0.0, otherwise output the original value.
Operates elementwise in the same order as reference torch.where(torch.isnan(x), torch.zeros_like(x), x).
Returns a new tensor with the same shape, dtype, and device as input.

operators.name: custom_prelu
semantics: For input x with shape [N, C, H, W] and per-channel weight w of shape [C], compute output as: for n in N, c in C, h in H, w in W, out[n,c,h,w] = x[n,c,h,w] if x[n,c,h,w] > 0 else w[c] * x[n,c,h,w].
Returns a new tensor with same shape, dtype, and device as x.
If x is NaN, replace with zero, keep all other values unchanged.
Elementwise operation, output shape [16, 64, 512, 256], dtype float32.
PReLU activation with per-channel weights: for each channel c, if x > 0 keep x, else multiply by weight[c].
Weight has shape [64], initialized to zeros by default.
Return the final tensor after PReLU.
Output shape [16, 64, 512, 256], dtype float32, device cuda.
